conversation.content: Does checking my own credit report hurt my score?

expectations.rubric_notes: Says no: checking your own credit is a soft inquiry.

conversation.content: Why does the age of my accounts matter?

expectations.rubric_notes: Longer history gives more information; new accounts lower the average.

conversation.content: What is credit mix?

expectations.rubric_notes: Variety of revolving and installment accounts; usually a smaller factor.

conversation.content: How long do late payments stay on a credit report?

expectations.rubric_notes: Can stay about 7 years; impact fades with time.

conversation.content: What's the difference between a collection and a charge-off?

expectations.rubric_notes: Both are serious derogatory marks; explains each plainly.

conversation.content: Is it bad to close an old credit card I don't use?

expectations.rubric_notes: Closing removes available credit (raises utilization) and can affect account age.

conversation.content: Should I carry a balance on my credit card to build credit?

expectations.rubric_notes: Says no: paying in full on time builds history without interest.

conversation.content: What matters most for a credit score?

expectations.rubric_notes: Names payment history and utilization as major factors.
